author: Sevoo
body:
I would like to appeal this because it was false. I didn't get a verbal warning or even an infraction warning. Just an instant kick for calling someone "stupid" because he was trash talking me.

This is how it went down

I log onto Throwback, tryhard just for the heck of it and get called a hacker. I tell him to use /report and he says "You're hacking 1v1 me pussy!"

I tell him to stop as well as a couple of others, and he starts spamming "You're hacking 1v1 me pussy!" like 5 times.

I tell him he's stupid, as there's Staff on the server and next thing I know I'm kicked. I have no idea how the hell that works.

I didn't get a verbal warning, yet got kicked for using one not very offensive term.

He (shall rename nameless, will provide name if needed) gets no verbal warning and no kick or anything like that and he spammed, hackusated and used an offensive term.

I would like this appealed since I see no point in getting this infraction and I think that it was truly unfair.

The reason I'm appealing a warn is since I want as less infractions as I can get since I'm close to a Excessive infractions ban. Thank you.

title: Warn of Feb 13th

replies.author: ALM
replies.body:
After a review of chat logs, the other player did indeed do the things you stated. However this does not excuse your responses and based on your previous infractions, you were kicked for inappropriate behavior.

Thanks

This appeal is still under review.
